name: ccxt
description: Official CCXT plugins for Claude: the hosted public market-data server (ccxt) and the local CCXT MCP server (ccxt-mcp), each bundled with its usage skill.

plugins.name: ccxt
plugins.description: The hosted CCXT MCP server (https://docs.ccxt.com/mcp) plus a usage skill — read-only public market data and interactive charts from major crypto exchanges. No install, no API keys.

plugins.name: ccxt-mcp
plugins.description: The official CCXT MCP server plus the ccxt-mcp usage skill — market data, balances and opt-in trading across 100+ crypto exchanges and prediction markets, with keys kept local.
